### Prerequisites:
- Available remote control and normal display screen

### Operation steps:
1. Aim at the IR icon on the device panel and press the ENTER button on the remote control to enter the login menu interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c0f5c2e57b01535a5530355306816d71)

2. Press the numeric keys to enter the password. The default password is 999999
3. Enter the main menu function interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=86c2d12bd7f39662684e8f1a50b50135)
